name: Anime Season Collections
description: Automatically groups Anime and Animation seasons into Winter, Spring, Summer, and Autumn collections based on season premiere dates, with generated collage posters and logos.
overview: Automatic seasonal collections for Anime and Animation libraries in Jellyfin 12.

versions.changelog: Uses Jellyfin BoxSet LinkedChildren for authoritative collection membership checks and post-add verification. Also moves plugin metadata/artwork writes before AddToCollectionAsync to reduce collection.xml save races triggered by Jellyfin's queued collection refresh.

Fixes collection membership detection by checking only direct BoxSet members instead of recursive descendants. Adds post-add verification and detailed logging for any Season that still fails to become a direct collection member.

Initial Jellyfin 12 repository release. Supports Anime/Animation genre matching, library include/exclude filters, seasonal collection creation, release-date metadata, generated poster collages and logos, and a scheduled refresh task.

name: Background Upscaler
description: AI-upscales exact 1920x1080 local Jellyfin artwork to validated 3840x2160 output using Real-ESRGAN, with per-library selection.
overview: AI 1080p-to-4K artwork upscaling for selected Jellyfin 12.1 libraries.

versions.changelog: Adds an optional 1280x720 Backdrop toggle. 1920x1080 Backdrops still upscale 2x to 3840x2160; when enabled, exact 1280x720 Backdrops upscale 3x to the same 4K target. Backdrop-only filtering and all 12.1.0.4 safety features remain.

Major safety update: processes Backdrop images only, ignores posters/Primary/thumbs/logos/banners, defaults to the more reliable realesr-animevideov3 model, enables backups by default for new configs, adds single-image test mode and per-image timing logs, and documents the persistent Vulkan Docker setup.

Fixes Real-ESRGAN startup inside Docker by using /opt/realesrgan/realesrgan-ncnn-vulkan as the normal executable path and resolving the Docker mount automatically. Also removes the unavailable realesrnet-x4plus model option.
Fixes selected libraries scanning as 0 items. The plugin now correctly finds media inside the libraries you checked.

First public release. Adds scheduled AI upscaling of exact 1920x1080 Jellyfin artwork to validated 3840x2160, with per-library selection, Real-ESRGAN/GPU/model settings, and optional original backups.
